items.summary: fix(agents): internal session turns keep the pinned system prompt and prompt cache (#183898) * fix(agents): keep the pinned system prompt across internal session turns The pinned system-prompt series is keyed by the turn's personal-bootstrap profile, which only eligible external human turns set. Subagent completions, sessions_send, goal continuation, and cron or restart wakes in the same session got no profile, so every human/internal switch restarted the series and re-sent fresh instructions, losing the whole provider prompt cache. Internal turns that continue a session now use that session's selection through isSessionPersonalBootstrapTurn, except isolated cron sessions; ineligible external turns are unchanged so their restart still keeps the owner's overlay out of their requests. Live/queued replies and the gateway command path share the rule. The series route key gets one byte-identical owner, and cache-drop warnings report systemPromptSeries=pinned|restarted:. * test(gateway): expect internal_system chat turns to use the session selection Internal turns that continue a session now use that session's personal selection, so the chat-send system-provenance case is eligible for personal bootstrap; the separate assertions that internal input records no human contribution are unchanged.
